turns.customer: I've used the Glowworm headlamp from order #1050 on a few night hikes, and now it won't turn on, even with new batteries. Can I return it?
turns.reply: Because the headlamp stopped working after use, it is not eligible for a standard return, but it may be covered under our 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. I have escalated this to a human team member for review (Ticket #ESC-34), and someone will follow up by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
